definitions.gloss: facial tissues — soft disposable paper tissues, typically sold in a box
definitions.explanation: A loanword referring to the soft disposable paper tissues used for blowing the nose or wiping the face. Almost always means boxed or pocket-pack facial tissues; crepe paper and gift tissue paper (the English sense of 'tissue paper') are expressed differently. In everyday speech, often shortened to just ティッシュ.

examples.japanese: ティッシュペーパー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{鼻|はな}をかむ→鼻をかむ：20073_hanawokamu⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ティッシュペーパー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use tissues to blow my nose.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ティッシュペーパー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧なくなる。
examples.english: During hay-fever season, tissues run out quickly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{広告|こうこく}→広告：02747_koukoku⟧つき⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ティッシュペーパー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{配|くば}っていた→配る：03921_kubaru⟧。
examples.english: They were handing out tissues with advertising on them in front of the station.

notes:
Refers to facial tissues — the soft disposable paper sold in boxes or small plastic packets. In Japan, promotional tissue packs (⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧) printed with advertising are often handed out on the street.

USAGE:
- Usually shortened to ⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧ in conversation: ⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧?, ⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧⟦{取|と}って→取る：00565_toru⟧.
- Counted with ⟦{枚|まい}→〜枚：00650_mai⟧ for single sheets and ⟦{箱|はこ}→箱：02162_hako⟧ for boxes.
- The full form ティッシュペーパー is more common on packaging, in writing, and when being explicit.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ティッシュペーパー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to take a tissue
- ティッシュペーパー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鼻|はな}をかむ→鼻をかむ：20073_hanawokamu⟧: to blow one's nose with a tissue
- ⟦{箱|はこ}ティッシュ→箱ティッシュ：26511_hakotisshu⟧: box of tissues
- ⟦ポケット→ポケット：02964_poketto⟧⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧: pocket tissues
- ⟦{配|くば}り→配る：03921_kubaru⟧⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧: promotional tissues handed out on the street

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧: the common casual short form.
- ちり{紙|がみ}: an older native word for disposable paper tissues; still used, especially by older speakers.
- ⟦{鼻紙|はながみ}→鼻紙：24766_hanagami⟧: literally 'nose paper'; a somewhat dated equivalent of ちり{紙|がみ}.
- ⟦キッチンペーパー→キッチンペーパー：25045_kicchinpeepaa⟧: kitchen paper towel — thicker, for wiping up spills; not used as a facial tissue.
